note: Events that belong to contracts (S3.4, D-115): the basic inspection at a checkpoint, which comes before any other checkpoint event while contraband is aboard (`priority`), and a salvage claim, which opens whenever we stand at the claim point with the claim unworked. The format is described at the top of src/narrative/events.js.

items.title: Inspection at {place}
items.text: A Receivers cutter holds the lane with its lights on and its clamp already run out. The officer on the channel wants a scanner team through our lock, and is polite about it in the way of someone who does not have to be.

choices.label: Stand by the lock for them

outcomes.text: The cutter comes alongside and the clamp bangs onto the hull. Whatever is in the hold, there is a minute to decide where it ought to be.

choices.label: Put someone on the channel who can talk

outcomes.text: {voice} reads the officer a clause from the company's own transit charter, slowly. Nobody on that cutter wants to be the one who looks it up. The lane clears.
{voice} talks well, and the officer listens, and runs the clamp out anyway.

choices.label: Burn through the line before they board

outcomes.text: The cutter is slow to turn. By the time it has, you are a heat trace and a name on a list.
The cutter was waiting for exactly that. It is on the scope and coming after us.

items.title: The claim at {place}
items.text: The Aphelion turns slowly where the claim token says she will be, an ore tender with her lights out and her airlock cut open. The cut marks are still bright. Somebody has been here, and not long ago.

outcomes.text: It takes the whole watch. The crew come back black to the elbows with four crates of salvage and nothing worse than a cut hand.
You are three crates in when a ship comes round her hull with its guns out, and a voice on the channel says the claim is theirs.
{cutter} opens the sealed bay in twenty minutes with a cutting rig and a lot of language. Everything worth taking is in there, packed and tagged by whoever ran out of time before you.

choices.label: Take what is near the lock and go

outcomes.text: Two crates from the lock bay, and you are gone before anyone else arrives. The rest of her stays where she is.
You log her position again. The claim will keep. Whoever cut that airlock may not wait as long.
